timing: the Flying restriction is checked for every proposed blocker-attacker pair
choices: the defending player chooses among block pairs remaining legal after all represented restrictions
layers: the canonical represented layer-6 result is consumed; unsupported ability-changing producers fail trusted preflight
copy: the current represented copied keyword state is consumed; unsupported copy producers fail trusted preflight
zone_change: reach is relevant only for a current battlefield creature proposed as a blocker
source_leaves: the exception ceases when reach is absent from the current effective keyword state

variants: reach affects only the Flying restriction
